method: Cross-reference of live establishments schema (48 columns, registry-national-d-cms-schema-audit.json), the existing owner settings page (src/app/dashboard/ecole/parametres/page.tsx), and this sprint's live behavioral tests.

REGISTRY_PROTECTED.also: establishment_registry_identifiers.* (separate table, already fully protected — RLS, platform_admin-select-only, no write policy for any client role)

PLATFORM_ADMIN_ONLY.protection: protect_establishment_privileged_columns() trigger (0014) — live-confirmed active this sprint (owner is_verified self-write attempt correctly blocked, error 42501)

SERVER_MANAGED_IMPLICIT.protection: id/owner_id: no explicit trigger, but Postgres reuses the RLS USING expression (auth.uid() = owner_id) as the implicit WITH CHECK when none is specified — an owner cannot reassign owner_id away from themselves (would fail WITH CHECK). Not independently behaviorally re-tested this sprint (already established via static RLS-semantics analysis in REGISTRY-NATIONAL-D). created_at is not enforced anywhere; low-risk (no security implication from a timestamp an owner could technically backdate), not remediated this sprint.

OWNER_EDITABLE_NOW.note: Already exposed via src/app/dashboard/ecole/parametres/page.tsx's own form. Confirmed unaffected by 0023 (trigger only inspects the 6 registry columns).

OWNER_EDITABLE_LATER_CMS.note: Live columns, currently owner-writable (no trigger blocks them, not yet exposed in the settings UI), no known blocker. Reasonable CMS-A candidates.

PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED.note: slug/category changes have knock-on effects (routing, search taxonomy) independent of registry concerns. organization_id's semantics were not investigated this sprint (out of scope) — flagged rather than assumed safe.
